tei:div.tei:p: (na)༄༅// sgrub thabs brgya rtsa nas bshad pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi mngon rtogs rjes gnang gi cho ga dang bcas pa'i tho yig mun sel sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru rat+na war+dhā ya/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ngo bo nyid// sgrub la dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i// yi dam lha tshogs la btud nas// sgrub thabs kun las btus pa nas// byung ba'i yi dam lha tshogs kyi// mngon rtogs rjes gnang cho gar bcas// dam pa'i gsung bzhin bshad kyis nyon// snying rje chen po dang ldan pa ba ri lo tsā bas phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs brgya rtsar grags pa'i rjes gnang gi cho ga ni/ gnas dben par maṇ+ḍa lar dri bzang gis thig le byas te/ thog mar rdo rje gdan gtso 'khor gsum pa'i tshom bu dgod/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod dang gtor ma bsham/ rjes gnang du byed kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i gtor ma dang lha bshos logs su sta gon bya/ slob dpon gyi mdun du ting ting shags dang*/ me tog la sogs pa bshams la/ mchod pa rnams/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa ces pas bsang*/ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dhūp+pe swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ya swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra shab+da swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra dharma ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsa li ni/ pradz+nyā pā ra mi ta nā da saṃ bha we/

badz+ra satwa hṛ da ya san+to ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swā hā/ zhes dang so so'i phyag rgya bya zhing mthar rol mo dkrol te byin dbab/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mche'o// bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du 'od zer can ma'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi// zhes skyabs sems mdor bsdus bya/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig ces tshad med bzhi bsgom/ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ gi sngags brjod de/ rang gi phung po khams dang skye mched thams cad mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las phag ser po'i rgyab tu pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du mam̐ yig ser po de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid 'od zer can ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon mya ngan med pa'i shing gi yal ga 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/

mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'od zer can ma'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par bsams la/ thugs kar sa bon gyi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba la 'od zer 'phros pas 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs te rang la gnyis su med par thim par bsam zhing*/ oṃ mā ri ts+yai māṃ swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la dngos grub kyi skal ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te rang la thim par bsam/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ gis mdun bskyed bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las phag ser gyi rgyab tu pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du mam̐ yig ser po de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid 'od zer can ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon mya ngan med pa'i shing gi yal ga 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/

mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'od zer can ma'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par bsams la/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ gis gtor ma bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ las kha dog dang dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlab/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang*/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum gyis dbul/ mchod bstod bsdus pa bya/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar sa bon gyi mthar sngags phreng bsams la/ spro bsdu'i dmigs pas thugs rgyud bskul bar bsam zhing gong ltar bzlas pa ci rigs bya/ slob ma rnams khrus dang phyag byas la snyim pa me tog dang bcas te 'khod pa la/ slob dpon gyis zang zing med pa'i byams pa dang*/ 'khor ba las sgrol 'dod kyi snying rje chen po sngon du 'gro bas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rjes su gnang ba zab mo nyan la don nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa'i byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan 'tshal/

de la 'jug sgo mang du yod pa las 'dir rgyud sde rin po che rnams nas lha'i rnal 'byor bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsungs pa rnams/ 'phags yul gyi slob dpon so sos thugs nyams su bzhes shing*/ sgrub pa'i thabs rgyas bsdus sna tshogs mdzad pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs kun las btus pa'am/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsar grags pa'i bstan bcos chen po nas byung ba'i yi dam khyad par can rnams kyi rjes su gnang ba bsgrub pa'i skabs su bab pa yin/ de las dang po thubaṃ paṃ rdo rje gdaṃn gtsoṃ 'khoṃr gsuṃm paṃ'i rjes su gnang ba bsgrub pa la/ slob dpon gyi bgyi bar 'os pa thams cad grub nas/ khyed rang gi ngo skal du gyur pa la maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba/ gsol ba 'debs pa/ rgyud yongs su dag par bya ba/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa rnams sngon du 'gro dgos pas slob dpon la lhag pa'i lha dang tha mi dad snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pas rjes gnang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul te/ me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// lhag pa lha yi ngo bo nyid// dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis// bdag la rjes gnang stsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab nas/ rgyud dag pa'i slad du mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i thubaṃ paṃ rdoṃ rjeṃ gdaṃn gaṃtso 'khoṃr gsumaṃ la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar bzhugs par mos pa byas te/ de rnams kyi spyan sngar bdag gzhan gyi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs nas sangs rgyas 'grub par shog ces pas rgyud dag par byas nas thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/

dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pas bdag la thubaṃ paṃ rdoṃ rjeṃ gdaṃn gaṃtso 'khoṃr gsumaṃ pa'iṃ sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba 'debs pa rnams rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi la/ thog mar rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa'i slad du slob dpon gyis/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs nas haṃ/ zhes brjod pas khyed rang gi phung po khams dang zhes sogs kyis slob ma rnams bdag bskyed ltar gtso 'khor rnams zhal phyag rdzogs par bskyed/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun bskyed dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs kar phog pas de thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul te/ thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo yin pa la/ rnam pa thubaṃ paṃ rdoṃ rjeṃ gdaṃn gaṃtso 'khoṃr gsumaṃ gyi sku tshad med grangs med/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te khyed rang gi lus la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ ces pa dang rol mo bya zhing*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badz+ra ā we sha ya aḥ.aḥ.aḥ zhes yang yang brjod pas bcoṃm ldanaṃ 'daṃs kyi sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/ lus bcoṃm ldanaṃ 'daṃs kyi sku dang nus pa mnyam par byin gyis brlabs snyam du mos pa mdzod/ rjes su bzlas pa'i lung gi slad du slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung*/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas 'thon/ khyed rang gi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi mthar 'khod par mos pa byas te me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ ces dang*/ sngags kyi rjes zlos lan gsum byar gzhug de ltar lan gsum bzlas pas dang pos rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/

gsum pas brtan par byas par mos te slob dpon la me tog gtor nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyi// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// lan gsum/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas/ slob dpon gyis kyang me tog gi phreng ba bsngags su byas te khyed rang gi spyi bor bzhag cing byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par gsol// rdo rje slob ma'i rgyud la bcoṃm ldanaṃ 'daṃs thubaṃ paṃ rdoṃ rjeṃ gdaṃn gaṃtso 'khoṃr rnamaṃs kyi gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig ces brjod cing me tog 'thor/ dam bca' ba'i lung gi slad du/ dus da nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob kyi bar du thubaṃ paṃ rdoṃ rjeṃ gdaṃn gaṃtso 'khoṃr gsumaṃ yi dam du gzung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus da nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ thubaṃ paṃ rdoṃ rjeṃ gdaṃn gaṃtso 'khoṃr gsumaṃ yi dam gyi lhar gzung bar bgyi'o// lan gsum/ de ltar byas pas bcoṃm ldanaṃ 'daṃs kyi gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/ ngag bcoṃm ldanaṃ 'daṃs kyi gsung dang nus pa mnyam par byin gyis brlabs snyam du mos pa mdzod/ byin gyis rlob pa'i lung gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pa mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te/ thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo bcoṃm ldanaṃ 'daṃs gtsoṃ 'khoṃr gyi sku mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam pa re thugs ka nas rgyangs kyis bye nas byon pa khyed rang gi spyi bo nas thim ste thugs ka'i hūm̐ṃ yigaṃ dang dbyer med du gyur par mos pa gyis/

de'i ngang nas lha sku snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu la yid cher gyis gtad pas 'khor rnams 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te rang la thim zhing*/ rang nyid lha sku gdan dang bcas pa 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te thugs ka'i sa bon la thim/ sa bon de yang je chung je phrar gyur te mthar nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar gyur pa la brten nas/ gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma dmigs pa'i stong nyid 'od gsal spros pa'i mtha' thams cad bral ba nam mkha' lta bu rgyud la skyes par mos pa byas te cung zad cig mnyam par 'jog mdzod/ de ltar byas pas bcoṃm ldanaṃ 'daṃs kyi thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ sems kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/ sems bcoṃm ldanaṃ 'daṃs kyi thugs dang nus pa mnyam par byin gyis brlabs snyam du mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod la sgrub thabs kyi lung bya/ rjes gnang gnyis pa la sgrub thabs du yod kyi lung yang 'dir bklags la/ tshom bu la mchod bstod/ 'dod don zhus te/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod// ces nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// zhes pa'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes dang*/ mtheb srin gyis se gol byas pas tshom bu'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la gnyis su med par thim par bsams la/ las kyi rdo rjes tshom bu rnying pa bsdus te gsar pa dgod/ mchod pa kha gso/ gtor ma gsar pa bsham/ de'i bar la slob dpon gyis skyabs 'gro nas mdun bskyed kyi bzlas pa'i bar gyi spyi'i chings thams cad gong bzhin las/

lha'i gdan/ sa bon/ gtso 'khor du yod/ rigs bdag sngags/ mchod pa'i sngon gyi mtshan sngags/ bstod pa rnams so sor sbyor tshul ma 'dres par shes par byas la nyams su blang*/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul la/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba gdab pa nas byin gyis rlob pa'i lung gi bar sngar gyi rigs 'gros sbyar la bya/ slar yang rjes gnang phyi ma'i sgrub thabs kyi lung bya ba sogs go rim thams cad sngar bzhin las/ chos thun re re bzhin yang rjes gnang dang po la gsol 'debs rgyun bshags sogs rgyas par bya zhing*/ rjes gnang phyi ma'i tshe 'das gtor gyi lhag ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs la/ g.yas lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥzhes mgron bkug la/ sngags de nyid kyi mthar a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis phul la/ 'jig rten pa yi 'byung po rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di snoms la// chos don bden pa la gnas nas// zhi zhing dul ba'i sems su mdzod// bdag kyang byang chub ma thob bar// gegs med bar chad med pa dang*// dam tshig gnas la gnas mdzod la// byang chub thob pa'i grogs kyang mdzod// ces pas phrin las gzhol/ lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra gats+tsha zhes pas 'jig rten pa'i mgron gshegs su gsol la/ mdun bskyed brtan byed kyi bzlas pa bya/ de nas rjes gnang phyi ma'i mthar/

'di'i dam tshig las blang nas shis brjod par spyi ltar dkyus su bkod pa'o// mdor na de dag gi gnas skabs su thob cing khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa la bsrung bsdam bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal ba// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi// zhes dam tshig bsdus te 'dzin par khas blangs nas rjes su gnang ba rnams rdzogs par thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas lus longs spyod thams cad slob dpon la 'bul/ cha shas nas longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du// khyod la bdag ni 'bul lags na// khyod kyi slob mar bzung ba dang*// cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// de rnams kyis rjes su gnang ba zab mo rnams gsan pa yin pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid// thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas te// skye rga na 'chi'i rba klong 'khrugs pa yi// srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba sgrol bar shog /ces brjod la slob ma rnams rang gnas su gtong*/ rjes chog ni/ slob dpon gyis mchod pa byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas mchod cing bstod/ 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyi mthar bzod gsol/ gshegs bsdu/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po zhes gnas gsum bsrung*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /yi dam lha tshogs 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces bsngo smon dang*/ ston mchog dam pa sogs bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa ji ltar rigs pa brjod par bya'o// ༈ /brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs gsum la spyi 'gro ngos zin par byas la/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng du mu las rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs brtan pa'i 'khor lo gur gum gzhon nu'i mdog lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas ral gri 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing*/

g.yon stong phrag brgya pa'i pusti thugs kar 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs kar 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte ba dang shar nas brtsams te phyogs bzhir a ra pa tsa na/ me nas brtsams te mtshams bzhir ni pra pañdza/ rtsibs rnams kyi bar mtshams brgyad du dbyangs yig gnyis gnyis te bcu drug mu khyud la kā li'i phreng ba/ de rnams gur gum gyi mdog lta bu 'od 'bar bar bsam/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ sngags/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na muḥ mtshan sngags/ ār+ya mañdzu shrī s+thi ra tsakra/ bstod pa/ gzhon nu'i sku lus 'chang ba po// ye shes sgron me rab tu gsal// 'jig rten gsum gyi mun sel ba// 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// ༈ /a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs gnyis 'og nas 'byung ba'i 'phral du nyams su myong ba'i 'jam dbyangs dang gsum la/ pad zla'i steng du dhīḥlas rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs a ra pa tsa na dkar po g.yas ral gri g.yon pusti 'dzin pa/ rgyan dang na bza' bzhugs tshul gong dang 'dra/ de'i thugs kar a las 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ dbus su oṃ las rang 'dra'i gtso bo/ mdun du ra las drwa ba can/ rgyab tu pa las zla 'od/ g.yas su tsa las skra can ma/ g.yon du na las nye ba'i skra can ma rnams zhal phyag gtso bo mtshungs pa/ yang na sa bon lnga bkod kyang btub/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ mtshan sngags/ ār+ya madz+nyu shrī sa pa ri wā ra/ bstod pa/ ri bong 'dzin pa ltar dkar glegs bam ral gris phyag mtshan zhing*// rab mdzes shin tu zhi ba'i gzhon nu zur phud lnga ldan pa// dga' ba rgya chen thar mchog spyan ni pad+ma'i 'dab ltar yangs// blo gros ngan pa sreg mdzad 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// ༈ /'jam pa'i rdo rje zhal gsum phyag drug pa ni/

pad zla'i steng du muḥser po las 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa zhal gur gum gyi mdog can/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dkar ba/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams na ral gri/ mda'/ mchog sbyin/ g.yon pa rnams na sher phyin gyi glegs bam/ ut+pa la sngon po/ gzhu/ rgyan dang na bza' bzhugs tshul 'dra/ rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan/ oṃ muḥ mtshan sngags 'dra/ bstod pa/ gzhon nu'i sku lus sogs// ༈ /'jam pa'i rdo rje lha lnga ni/ rma bya'i khri'i steng du pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi ba'i dbus su phyogs bzhir zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du/ dbus su hūm̐ las 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ shar nas brtsams te phyogs bzhir mo ha ku mā rī/ rā ga ku mā rī/ īr+ṣ+ya ku mā rī/ ku la ku mā rī rnams sku mdog dmar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rgyan dang na bza' bzhugs tshul gong dang 'dra/ yang na gtso bo'i thugs kar lha lnga bskyed yang rung*/ gtso bo la 'od dpag med/ 'khor rnams la gtso bo nyid kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ hrīḥmam̐ hoḥmam̐ hūm̐/ oṃ prūm̐ lam̐ hūm̐/ oṃ tram̐ tram̐ hūm̐/ oṃ hrī mam̐ hūm̐/ oṃ kham̐ tam̐ hūm̐/ mtshan sngags dang bstod pa 'dra// ༈ /ngag gi rgyal po ni/ seng ge sngon po mgo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng du pad+ma dang zla ba la mu yig gser btso ma'i mdog can las 'jam pa'i dbyangs ngag gi rgyal po sku mdog gser zhun ma lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis thugs kar chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i g.yon ut+pa la sngon po la gnas pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i pusti 'dzin pa/ rgyan dang na bza' 'dra/ zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yon mdun du khro bo gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas bcom ldan 'das kyi ngar gdong g.yon la brten cing*/ g.yon pas dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/

skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ thod pa'i phreng bas dbu la brgyan cing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ gtso bo la zhal blta ba'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ gshin rje'i gshed la gtso bo nyid kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ dharma dhā tu wā gī shwa ri mum̐ḥ mtshan sngags/ wā gī shwa ri sa pa ri wā ra/ bstod pa 'dra'o// ༈ /'jam dpal rgyal po rol pa ni/ seng ge dang pad zla la mam̐ las 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rgyal po rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas pus mo g.yas kyi steng du kha bub tu brkyang zhing*/ g.yon pas ut+pa la sngon po'i yu ba thugs kar bzung zhing 'dab ma snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba/ rgyan dang na bza' 'dra/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ wā gī shwa ri mum̐ḥ mtshan sngags/ oṃ wā gī shwa ra/ bstod pa 'dra// ༈ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod nas bsdus pa dang gsungs pa'i 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs gnyis ye shes kyi sbyor ba dang gsum ni/ pad zla la thig le dkar po las dhīḥyig dkar po de yongs su gyur pa las 'jam dpal a ra pa tsa na dkar po ral gri dang*/ pusti 'dzin pa/ rgyan dang na bza' 'dra/ rgyal po rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ dhīḥswā hā/ mtshan sngags/ mañdzu shrī/ bstod pa 'dra'o// ༈ /gur nas gsungs pa'i yan lag med pa'i rdo rje ni/ pad zla'i steng du ham̐ las yan lag med pa'i rdo rje 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mdog ser po phyag drug pa/ dang po gnyis kyi ut+pa la dmar po'i mde'u can gyi mda' dang me tog gi gzhu rna ba'i drung du 'gengs pa/ bar pa gnyis kyis ral gri dang ut+pa la sngon po/ 'og ma gnyis kyis me long dang mya ngan med pa'i shing gi yal ga 'dzin pa/ rgyan dang na bza' 'dra/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ mañdzu gho ṣa hrīḥdzaḥ

mtshan sngags/ a naṅga badz+ra mañdzu gho ṣa/ bstod pa 'dra'o// ༈ /chos dbyings gsung dbang ni/ pad zla'i steng du a yig las chos dbyings gsung gi dbang phyug dkar po zhal bzhi dkar ba/ phyag brgyad kyi dang po gnyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya/ g.yas 'og ma gsum na ral gri/ mda'/ rdo rje/ g.yon 'og ma gsum na sher phyin gyi pusti/ gzhu/ dril bu 'dzin pa/ rgyan dang na bza' 'dra/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ thugs kar hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ dpral bar trām̐ las rin po che ser po trām̐ gis mtshan pa/ mgrin par hrīḥlas pad+ma dmar po hrīḥs mtshan pa/ spyi gtsug tu a las sna tshogs rdo rje as mtshan pa bskyed/ rigs lngas dbur brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra tīk+ṣ+ṇa duḥkha ts+tshe da pradz+nyā dz+nyā na mūrta ye/ dz+nyā na kā ya wā gī shār a ra pa tsa nā ya te na maḥ mtshan sngags/ dharma dhā tu wā gī shwa ra/ bstod pa 'dra'o// ༈ /mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i 'jam dpal ni/ nam mkhar hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa bzhi rwa ba gur/ rdo rje de nyid zhu ba las byung ba'i 'od zer gyi rwa bas yongs su bskor ba'i nang du hrīḥlas pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du mum̐ yig las rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs zhal gsum phyag bzhi pa sku dang rtsa zhal dkar la dmar pa'i mdangs can/ phyag dang po gnyis kyi ral gyi dang pusti/ 'og ma gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ rgyan dang na bza' 'dra/ de'i thugs kar sems ma rdo rje ma dkar mo g.yas ral gri snying gar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ dpral bar rin chen rdo rje ser mo spyi bor me tog gi phreng ba 'dzin pa/ mgrin par pad+ma rdo rje ma dmar ser g.yon pad+ma 'dzin cing g.yas pas de'i kha 'byed pa/ spyi bor las kyi rdo rje ma ljang gu phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje rtse gsum pa 'tshir ba'i tshul gyis spyi bor 'dzin pa/

mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ sarba dharmā bhā wa/ swā bhā wa bi shud+dha badz+ra tsak+ṣuḥ a ā aṃ aḥ pra kṛ ti pa ri shud+dhaḥ sarba dharmā ya du ta/ sarba ta thā ga ta dz+nyā na kā ya/ madz+nyu shrī pa ri shud+dhi tā mu pā dā ya ti/ a āḥ sarba ta tha ga ta hṛ da ya ha ra ha ra/ oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥbha ga wān dz+nyā na mūrti/ wā gī shwa ra ma hā pā tsa/ sarba dharmā ga ga nā ma la su pa ri shud+dha dharma dhā tu dz+nyā na gar+bha āḥ mtshan sngags ni/ ār+ya mañdzu shrī/ bstod pa 'dra'o// ༈ /'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig grub ni/ pad zla'i steng du mam̐ yig las dpa' bo gcig tu grub pa dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon ut+pa la sngon po 'dzin pa/ rgyan dang na bza' 'dra/ rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ sngags oṃ wā kye daṃ na maḥ zhes dang*/ oṃ hrīḥhūm̐/ mtshan sngags/ ār+ya mañdzu badz+ra sid+dhi ka bī ra/ bstod pa 'dra'o// ༈ /'jam dpal shes rab 'khor lo ni/ pad zla la a yig las 'jam pa'i dbyangs shes rab 'khor lo dkar po ral gri dang pusti 'dzin pa/ rgyan na bza' bzhugs tshul gong ma dang 'dra/ de'i lte bar zla ba dang*/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs drug pa'i lte bar dhīḥlas rang 'dra'i rje btsun a ra pa tsa na/ rtsibs drug la oṃ badz+ra tīk+ṣ+ṇa dhām̐/ phyi skor la ṛ l̥ bzhi spangs pa'i dbyangs yig bcu gnyis/ mu khyud la nga nya na ma bzhi spangs pa'i gsal byed/ rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra tīk+ṣ+ṇa dhām̐/ mtshan sngags dang bstod pa 'dra'o// 'phral du nyams su myong ba'i 'jam dpal gyi rjes gnang gong gi a ra pa tsa na las logs su mi dgos// ༈ /gdong drug ni/ pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog nag po zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa zhal brtsegs ma gnyis nag po/ g.yas brtsegs ma gnyis dkar po/

g.yon brtsegs ma gnyis dmar po/ phyag dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol ba/ bar pa gnyis kyi tho ba dang zhags pa/ tha ma gnyis kyis ral gri dang gtun shing 'dzin pa/ zhabs mdun ma gnyis rdo rje skyil krung*/ bar pa gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang*/ tha ma gnyis g.yon bskum g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ dbu skra dang smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ thod pa skam po lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ sbrul dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ kṛṣ+ṇa ya mā ri/ bstod pa/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin khyod// sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa// sangs rgyas kun rab mchog gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dbang phyug khyod phyag 'tshal// zhes so// rjes gnang gi tshe/ sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ lus kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi bar byas/ lus bcom ldan 'das kyi sku dang nus pa mnyam par byin gyis brlabs pa yin zhes brjod/ gsung dang thugs la'ang des rigs 'gre zhing khro bo khro mo gzhan rnams la de bzhin sbyar ro// ༈ /gshin rje'i gshed nag po ni/ pam̐ las pad+ma dang am̐ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las gshin rje'i gshed nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbyug pa sngon po 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ rgyan dang cha lugs gong dang 'dra/ ma he dmar po'i steng na g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rigs bdag sngags/ bstod pa 'dra'o// ༈ /gshin rje'i gshed zhal gsum pa ni/ gzhan thams cad gong dang 'dra ba las/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa sku dang rtsa zhal sngo/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ phyag drug gi g.yas gsum na 'khor lo/ ral gri/ gtun shing*/

g.yon gsum na bet+ta lī ste gsal shing la btsugs pa'i ro/ dgra s+t+wa/ rdo rje zhags pa rnams 'dzin pa'o// ༈ /rdo rje chos ni/ pam̐ las pad+ma dang am̐ las zla ba la hrīḥlas rdo rje chos zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na pad+ma'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ rgyan dang cha lugs na bza' rnams zhi ba gzhan dang 'dra/ 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ hrīḥswā hā/ mtshan sngags/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā hrīḥ bstod pa/ 'dod chags rdo rje chos kyi sku// kun rtog ye shes rdo rje'i gsung*// ting 'dzin chen po'i phyag rgya can// phyag 'tshal snang ba mtha' yas la// zhes so// ༈ /seng ge sgra ni/ pam̐ las pad+ma dmar po'i steng du siṃ las seng ge dkar po mgo bo g.yas su bstan pa/ de'i steng du zla ba la hrīḥyig yongs su gyur pa las byung ba'i 'jig rten dbang phyug seng ge sgra sku mdog dkar po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ phyag g.yas pa pus mo'i steng du skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya brkyang zhing*/ g.yon pa sku rgyab tu gdan la brten pa/ dka' thub kyi cha lugs can/ rgyal po rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o// g.yas logs su sbrul dkar pos dkris pa'i rtse gsum bsgreng zhing*/ g.yon logs su pad+ma'i sdong bu'i steng du me tog dri zhim po'i tshogs kyis bkang ba'i thod pa dang ral gri me 'bar bas brgyan pa/ sku las de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i 'od zer 'phro ba/ rigs bdag 'od dpag med/ sngags oṃ āḥhrīḥsidha nā da hūm̐ phaṭa ces pa dang*/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥ.ār+yā a wa lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ ma hā satwā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ a ka ṭe/ bi ka ṭe/ ni ka ṭe/ ka ṭaṃ ka ṭe/ ka ro ṭe/ ka ro ṭe/ bīr+ye swā hā/

'di la ka ro ṭe med pa dang*/ bi d+ya zhes pa'ang snang*/ mtshan sngags/ ār+ya sidha nā da/ bstod pa/ skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis dbu la brgyan// thugs rje'i spyan gyis 'gro la gzigs// spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// ༈ /ha la ha la gong 'og gnyis ni/ pad dmar dang zla ba'i steng du hrīḥyig las 'jig rten dbang phyug ha la ha la zhal gsum phyag drug pa sku dang rtsa zhal dkar po/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon ser ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag drug gi g.yas gsum na mchog sbyin/ bgrang phreng*/ mda'/ g.yon gsum na rang gi pus mo'i steng na gnas pa'i 'dod pa'i lha mo'i nu ma dang*/ pad dkar gyi sdong bu yal ga gsum pa dang*/ gzhu rnams 'dzin pa/ thod pa'i phreng ba dang zla ba phyed pas dbur brgyan pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ rin po che'i ri'i phug na rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ g.yas ngos su sbrul gyis dkris pa'i rtse gsum dang*/ g.yon du me tog gis bkang ba'i thod pa gnyis kyang pad+ma'i steng na gnas pa/ 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ sngags oṃ ha la ha la hrīḥzhes dang*/ oṃ badz+ra dharma hrīḥ mtshan sngags/ oṃ lo ke shwa ra/ bstod pa 'dra'o// ༈ /kha sar+pā ṇi ni/ pad zla la hrīḥlas spyan ras gzigs kha sar+pā ṇi sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon pad+ma 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i cod pan gyis brgyan pa/ rgyan dang na bza' 'dra/ skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas la logs su sgrol ma ljang gu g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon ut+pa la 'dzin pa/ nor bzang ser po thal mo sbyar nas chos kyi ka chos kyi snod sho kha li'i ming ngo*/ ba li 'dzin pa/ g.yon du khro gnyer can ser mo g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon dbyu gu gsum pa 'dzin pa/ rta mgrin dmar po g.yas phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul dang*/

g.yon dbyug pa aṃ tshugs su byas pa/ gtso bo la 'od dpag med dang 'khor rnams la gtso bo nyid kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ hrīḥswā hā/ mtshan sngags/ lo ke shwa ra kha sar+pā ṇi sa pa ri wā ra/ bstod pa 'dra'o// ༈ /yi ge drug pa gtso 'khor gsum pa ni/ pad dkar dang zla ba'i steng du hrīḥlas dbus su 'jig rten dbang phyug sku mdog dkar po/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas 'og mas bgrang phreng dang*/ g.yon 'og mas pad dkar 'dzin pa/ rgyan dang bza' 'dra/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i g.yas su nor bu 'dzin pa dang*/ g.yon du 'bru drug ma gnyis sku mdog dang rgyan dang cha lugs gtso bo dang mtshungs pa/ 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ sngags oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ mtshan sngags dang bstod pa 'dra'o// ༈ /ha ri ha ri ha ri la zhon pa ni/ yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me/ wam̐ las chu/ lam̐ las sa/ sum̐ las ri rab rnams gong nas gong du brtsegs pa'i steng du pad zla la hrīḥlas 'jig rten dbang phyug ha ri ha ri ha ri la zhon pa sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig pa/ phyag drug gi g.yas kyi dang pos sangs rgyas rnams dpang por gsol ba/ gnyis pas phreng ba/ gsum pas ngan song na gnas pa'i sems can la dge ba nye bar ston pa'i phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yon gyi dang pos dbyug pa/ gnyis pas ri dwags nag po'i pags pa/ gsum pas ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ rgyan dang na bza' 'dra/ rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ sngags oṃ hrīḥswā hā/ mtshan sngags dang bstod pa 'dra'o// ༈ /pad+ma gar dbang ni/ pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba la hrīḥlas spyan ras gzigs pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yon pas rang 'dra'i yum gos dkar mo dmar mo la 'khyud pa'i tshul gyis pad+ma dmar po 'dzin cing*/ g.yas pas de'i kha 'byed pa/

'dab ma brgyad la shar du rnam gzigs dkar mo g.yon pad+ma dmar po/ lhor sgrol ma ljang gu g.yon pad ljang*/ nub tu pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ma ser mo g.yon ut+pal sngon po/ byang du khro gnyer can dkar mo g.yon pad ser/ byang shar du pad+ma'i gnas can ma ser mo g.yon pad dmar/ shar lhor pad+ma'i dbang phyug ma sngon mo g.yon pad dkar/ lho nub tu sna tshogs pad+ma dkar mo g.yon pad sngon/ nub byang du sna tshogs rdo rje ma sna tshogs mdog g.yon sna tshogs pad+ma 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyi phyag g.yas pas g.yon gyi pad+ma rnams kyi kha 'byed pa/ gtso 'khor thams cad rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ gtso bo la 'od dpag med dang*/ 'khor rnams la gtso bo nyid kyis dbur brgyan/ sngags oṃ hrīḥpad+ma narte shwa re hūm̐/ mtshan sngags/ oṃ pad+ma narte shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra/ bstod pa/ gang gi rang bzhin chags bral yang*// chags pa can la chags pa dang*// mthun par bstan pas chags sogs rnams// zhi mdzad de la phyag 'tshal lo /zhes so// ༈ /sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rim pa'i 'jig rten dbang phyug drag po ni/ nam mkhar ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ de yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ gur/ bla bre/ me ri 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i nang du dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su pad+ma dmar po dang nyi ma'i steng du hrīḥlas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug zhal lnga pa sku dang rtsa zhal nag po/ g.yas su dkar pa dang dmar pa'i zhal gnyis/ g.yon du ser ba dang ljang ba'i zhal gnyis te thams cad kyang spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag bcu gnyis kyi g.yas pa drug na rnge'u chung*/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga lcags kyu/ zhags pa/ rdo rje/ mda' rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa drug na sdigs mdzub/

thod pa/ pad+ma dmar po/ nor bu/ 'khor lo/ gzhu rnams 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya drug dang ldan zhing mi mgo'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan/ sngags oṃ āḥhūm̐ i ti mu ni pa ra badz+re hrīḥhūm̐ dzaḥ mtshan sngags/ ār+ya a wa lo ki te shwa ra/ bstod pa/ gang gi rang bzhin khro bral yang*// khro ba can la khro ba dang*// mthun par bstan pas khro sogs rnams// zhi mdzad de la phyag mtshal lo// zhes so// ༈ /dbang du byed pa'i sgrol ma ni/ pad zla la tām̐ las 'phags ma sgrol ma sku mdog ljang gu g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon ut+pa la 'dzin pa/ rgyan dang na bza' zhi ba gzhan dang 'dra/ zhabs gnyis rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re sarba sa twa wā shaṃ me nā ya swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ ār+yā tā rā/ bstod pa/ lha dang lha min cod pan gyis// zhabs kyi pad+mo la btud de// phongs pa kun las sgrol mdzad ma// sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// ༈ /sgrol dkar gtso 'khor gsum pa ni/ sum̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i ri rab kyi steng du pad zla la hūm̐ las sgrol ma dkar mo phyag bzhi ma dang po gnyis ut+pa la'i phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yas 'og mas yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang bcas pa'i mchog sbyin/ g.yon 'og mas ut+pa la'i snye ma 'dzin pa/ rgyan dang na bza' bzhugs tshul 'dra/ de'i g.yas su zla ba la 'od zer can ser mo g.yas rnga yab dkar po dang*/ g.yon mya ngan med pa'i shing gi yal ga 'dzin pa/ sha 'gag dmar po dang sham thabs sngon po gsol ba/ g.yon du zla ba la rma bya chen mo ljang ser g.yas rnga yab/ g.yon rma bya'i mjug sgro 'dzin pa/ na bza' sna tshogs gsol ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa lngas dbur brgyan/ oṃ bha ga wa tī tā re ma ma hṛ da yaṃ pra bi sha swā hā/ zhes pas byin gyis brlab/

oṃ na ma stā re ma no ha re hūm̐ ha ra swā hā/ mtshan sngags 'dra/ bstod pa/ 'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma// tut+tā re yis 'jigs brgyad sgrol// tu res na ba rnams las sgrol// sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// ༈ /seng ldeng nags sgrol ni/ pad zla la tām̐ las sgrol ma ljang gu g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon ut+pal 'dzin pa/ rgyan dang na bza' bzhugs tshul 'dra/ g.yas su 'od zer can ser mo g.yon mya ngan med pa'i shing gi yal ga g.yon du ral gcig ma nag mo g.yon thod pa/ gnyis ga'i g.yas rnga yab/ rin po che dang dar gyi na bza' can mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ mtshan sngags dang bstod pa 'dra// ༈ /sgrol dkar tshe sbyin ma ni/ pad dkar dang zla ba la sgrol ma dkar mo g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon ut+pa la 'dzin pa/ ston ka'i zla ba'i 'od can/ zla ba la rgyab brten pa/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rgyan dang na bza' 'dra/ thugs kar 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar tām̐/ de'i mthar oṃ hā'i nang du chud pa'i rang gi ming gi yi ge rtsibs brgyad la/ tā/ re/ tuta/ tā/ re/ tu/ re/ swā/ 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ sngags/ mtshan sngags/ bstod pa rnams 'dra// ༈ /o ḍi yā na'i 'od zer can dmar mo'i sgrub thabs gong 'og gnyis la/ dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su mchod rten gyi bum pa'i nang du phag bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta la pam̐ las pad+ma dang am̐ las nyi ma'i steng du oṃ mam/ mām̐ las 'od zer can sku mdog dmar mo zhal drug ma/ rtsa zhal dmar po/ g.yas su nag po dang dkar po'i zhal gnyis/ g.yon du ser po dang ljang gu'i zhal gnyis/ steng du phag zhal nag po ste drug ka'ang spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag bcu gnyis kyi g.yas drug na ral gri/ 'khor lo/ gtun shing*/

mda'/ dgra s+t+wa/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa/ g.yon drug na sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ thod pa/ mya ngan med pa'i shing gi yal ga tshangs pa'i mgo bo/ gzhu/ rtse gsum rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa'i gru mor kha ṭ+wām̐ ga bsnams pa/ dbu skra kham pa gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo'i do shal dang*/ rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i mdun du lha mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma g.yas rdo rje dang khab/ g.yon mya ngan med pa'i shing dang sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ sha 'gag ser po dang stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ gnyi ga la rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ mā rī ts+yai oṃ mām̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ mā rī ts+yai mām̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ oṃ mā rī ts+yai/ bstod pa/ gang gi mtshan tsam 'dzin cing dran pas kyang*// bar du gcod pa kun las sgrol mdzad cing*// dri med bde ba chen po stsol mdzad ma// lha mo 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// ༈ /rtog pa nas byung ba'i 'od zer can ser mo gong 'og gnyis ni/ mchod rten gyi bum pa'i nang du nyi ma la oṃ las rnam par snang mdzad dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ zhi ba'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing*/ seng ge'i khri la bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs kar phag bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta la yam̐ las rlung dang*/ ham̐ las sgra gcan zla ba dang nyi ma 'dzin pa'i steng du pad+ma dang zla ba la mām̐ yig las 'od zer can sku mdog ser mo zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma/ rtsa zhal ser/ g.yas dmar/ g.yon phag pa'i zhal sngon po/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas pa bzhi na rdo rje/ lcags kyu/ mda'/ khab/ g.yon bzhi na mya ngan med pa'i yal ga gzhu/ skud pa/

sdigs mdzub/ sha 'gag dmar po mnabs shing*/ rin po che dang g.yer kha'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ de'i shar du bat+tā li dmar mo phag gi gdong pa can/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas khab dang lcags kyu/ g.yon zhags pa dang mya ngan med pa'i shing 'dzin pa/ sha 'gag dmar po can/ lhor ba dā li ser mo phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas mya ngan med pa'i yal ga dang khab/ g.yon rdo rje dang zhags pa/ nub tu ba rā li dkar mo phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas rdo rje dang khab/ g.yon zhags pa dang mya ngan med pa'i yal ga byang du ba rā hā mu khi dmar mo spyan gsum ma/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas rdo rje dang mda'/ g.yon zhags pa dang mya ngan med pa'i yal ga 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang lang tsho la bab pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ mā rī ts+yai mām̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ mtshan sngags dang bstod pa 'dra// ༈ /rtog pa las gsungs pa'i 'od zer can dkar mo ni/ mchod rten gyi nang du pad zla la mām̐ las 'od zer can dkar mo zhal lnga phyag bcu zhabs bzhi ma/ rtsa zhal dkar/ g.yas nag g.yon dmar ba phag gi gdong can/ rgyab zhal ljang*/ steng zhal ser ba/ phyag g.yas lnga na nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ rdo rje sngon po/ mda'/ lcags kyu/ khab/ g.yon lnga na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ gzhu/ mya ngan med pa'i yal ga sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ skud pa rnams 'dzin pa/ rin po che dang g.yer kha'i phreng bas brgyan cing*/ sha 'gag dang stod g.yogs dkar po can/ phag bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta'i steng na g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis khyab 'jug dang*/ dbang po dang*/ bde byed dang*/ tshangs pa rnams mnan pa/ de'i mdun du shing rta de nyid la gnas pa'i chu srin gyi steng du lha mo phag zhal can nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang sdigs mdzub/ g.yas phyogs su lha mo phag zhal can dmar mo phyag bzhi'i g.yas lcags kyu dang khab/ g.yon sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa dang skud pa 'dzin pa/

g.yon phyogs su lha mo phag zhal can dmar mo phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis kyis mda' gzhu rna ba'i drung du 'gengs pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis rdo rje dang mya ngan med pa'i yal ga 'dzin pa/ gsum ga'ang rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ shing rta 'dren pa'i phag gi 'og na nyi ma la sogs pa'i gza' dgu dang*/ nyer 'tshe byed pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs mi'i gzugs kyis gnas pa/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ sngags/ mtshan sngags/ bstod pa 'dra// ༈ /mya ngan med pa'i 'od zer can ni/ phag ser po'i rgyab tu pad zla la mam̐ las 'od zer can ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon mya ngan med pa'i shing gi yal ga 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ rigs bdag 'dra/ oṃ mā rī ts+yai mām̐ swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ bstod pa 'dra// ༈ /o ḍi yā na'i rim pa'i 'od zer can ni/ sna tshogs rdo rje yongs su gyur pa las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba gur bla bre ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du shin tu 'jigs pa'i dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su o ḍi yā na'i gnas kyi ngo bo chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum dkar la dmar ba'i nang du nyi ma la hūm̐ yig yongs su gyur pa las lha mo 'od zer can sku mdog dmar mo zhal drug phyag bcu gnyis ma/ rtsa ba'i zhal dmar po/ g.yas su ser po dang nag po'i zhal gnyis/ g.yon du dkar po dang nag po'i zhal gnyis/ steng du phag pa'i zhal nag po/ re re'ang spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag bcu gnyis kyi g.yas pa drug na ral gri/ sna tshogs rdo rje/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa/ dgra s+t+wa/ mda'/ gtun shing*/ g.yon pa drug na sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i khab/ rtse gsum/ mya ngan med pa'i yal ga

gzhu/ zhags pa/ tshangs pa'i mgo bo rnams 'dzin pa/ dbu skra kham pa gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo'i phreng ba dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i stod g.yogs can/ ha ha zhes drag tu dgod cing bdud bzhi mnan pa'i zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra dhā twī shwa ri sarba duṣ+ṭān/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ oṃ mā rī ts+yai mām̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra be tā lī hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ mā rī ts+yai oṃ mām̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

la lar hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa snang*/ mtshan sngags/ bstod pa 'dra// ༈ /tsun+da ni/ pad zla la tsum̐ las lha mo skul byed ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas dang po mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon dang po pad dkar gyi steng na sher phyin gyi pusti/ 'og ma gnyis mnyam gzhag gi steng na lhung bzed 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ tsa le tsu le tsun+de swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ ār+yā tsun+dā/ bstod pa/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ngo bo nyid// sgrub la dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i// yi dam lha la phyag 'tshal lo// bstod pa dmigs bsal med pa rnams spyi bstod 'dis bstod do// ༈ /shrī dzam+bha la ni/ pad zla la dzam̐ yig yongs su gyur pa las dzam+bha la ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas bī dza pū ra ka dang*/ g.yon rin po che'i char 'bebs pa'i ne'u le 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis kyis dung dang pad+ma'i gter mnan pa/ ut+pa la sngon po'i phreng ba dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rin chen 'byung ldan gtso bor gyur ba'i rigs lngas dbur brgyan/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+rā ya swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ ār+ya dza m+bha la/ bstod pa/ nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gter mnga' zhing*// gnod sbyin nor 'chang mang po kun gyi rje// byang phyogs skyong ba'i mgon po dzam+bha la// dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// ༈ /dzam+bha la uts+tshuṣ+ma ni/ pad zla la hūm̐ las dzam+bha la sku mdog nag po mi'u thung gi gzugs can gsus pa 'phyang ba/ gcer bu rna ba ma phug pa/ skra kham pa gyen du brdzes shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ g.yas na thod pa khrag gis gang ba dang*/ g.yon na rin po che sna tshogs skyugs pa'i ne'u le 'dzin pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis nor bdag ser po kha nas rin po che skyugs pa mnan pa/

rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan/ sngags/ mtshan sngags/ bstod pa 'dra// ༈ /nor rgyun ma ni/ pad zla la pam̐ las lha mo nor rgyun ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang*/ g.yon 'bras kyi snye ma dang rin po che sna tshogs kyi char 'bebs pa'i bum pa 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mdza' ba'i skye 'gro rnams kyis yongs su bskor ba/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ shrī ba su ni dha na k+ṣe tre swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ ba su dha rī/ bstod pa/ phun tshogs dge legs kun 'byung bcom ldan ma// dpal dang 'byor ba'i dbang phyug nor rgyun ma// yid la re ba'i bkra shis stsol mdzad ma// bsam 'phel dkyil 'khor dbang phyug ma la 'dud// ces so// ༈ /khro gnyer can ni/ pad zla la bh+ṝṃ las lha mo khro gnyer can sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma g.yas mchog sbyin dang phreng ba/ g.yon dbyug pa dang ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i cod pan can/ cung zad khro zhing zhi ba/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ bh+ṝṃ swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ ār+yā bh+ṝṃ ku ṭī/ bstod pa/ dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs spyi bstod bya// ༈ /byams mgon ni/ pad zla la maiṃ las rje btsun byams pa mgon po zhal gsum phyag bzhi pa gur gum gyi mdog can/ phyag dang po gnyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yas 'og mas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon 'og mas klu shing gi me tog bsnams pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ zhi ba'i rgyan dang na bza' can/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sprul pa du ma 'phro ba/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan/ oṃ maiṃ mai tri ya swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ ār+ya mai tri/ bstod pa/ byams chen me yis zhe sdang bud shing bsregs// ye shes 'od kyis ma rig mun pa sel// chos kyi rgyal tshab 'gro ba'i mgon gyur pa'i// dga' ldan bzhugs pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so//

༈ /gur gyi sher phyin ni/ pad zla la oṃ las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i mthil nas gyes pa'i g.yas ngos su pad+ma dkar po dang*/ g.yon ngos su dmar po'i steng du sher phyin gyi pusti re re 'dzin pa/ dbu skra phyed du li ba/ rgyan dang na bza' bzhugs tshul 'dra/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ pi tsu pi tsu pradz+nyā bar+dha ni/ dz+wa la dz+wa la me dhā bar+dha ni/ dhi ri dhi ri bud+dhi bar+dha ni swā hā/ mtshan sngags ār+yā pradz+nyā pā ra mi tā/ bstod pa/ smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin// ma skyes mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid// so so rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// ༈ /gdan bzhi dang sam+bu ṭa las gsungs pa'i sher phyin ni/ pad dkar dang zla ba la pram̐ las sher phyin dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis pad+ma gnyis kyi steng na sher phyin gyi pusti re re 'dzin pa/ rgyan dang na bza' rigs bdag 'dra/ rdo rje'am sems skyil gyis bzhugs pa/ oṃ praṃ swā hā/ oṃ pradz+nye ma hā pradz+nye hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ pradz+nye pradz+nye ma hā pradz+nye hūm̐ swā hā/ mtshan sngags bstod pa 'dra// ༈ /sher phyin ser mo'i sgrub thabs gnyis la/ pad zla'i steng du dhīḥlas sher phyin ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yon pas pad sngon gyi steng na sher phyin gyi pusti bsnams pa/ rgyan dang na bza' rigs bdag 'dra/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ oṃ pradz+nye ma hā pradz+nye shru ti smṛ ti bi dza ya dhiḥswā hā/ oṃ dhīḥshru ti smṛ ti bi dza ya swā hā/ mtshan sngags dang bstod pa 'dra// ༈ /yang sher phyin ser mo dang 'og nas 'byung ba'i gser mdog can gyi sher phyin gnyis la gzhan thams cad de dang 'dra ba las/ phyag gnyis kas ut+pa la'i steng na sher phyin gyi pusti re re 'dzin pa/

oṃ āḥdhīḥhūm̐ swā hā// ༈ /mi g.yo ba sngon po'i sgrub thabs gsum gzungs chog dang bcas pa la/ pad+ma dmar po dang nyi ma la hūm̐ las rjes btsun mi g.yo ba sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas ral gri nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ dmar zhing zlum pa'i spyan gnyis dang ldan pa/ ya sos ma mchu mnan pa/ dbu skra nag po'i thor tshugs can/ rin po che'i rgyan dang sbrul dkar po'i mchod phyir thogs kyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yon pa'i pus mo dang*/ g.yas pa'i rting pa gdan la btsugs te bzhengs ma stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ sku las 'od zer dmar po'i phreng ba 'phro ba/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ mtshan sngags/ ār+ya a tsa la/ bstod pa/ kye kye mtha' gnyis rnam par ma g.yos kyang*// mtha' bral bde chen khro bo'i rgyal po'i skur// sprul pa'i gzugs kyis 'gro don dpag med mdzad// 'jigs byed chen po 'gro ba kun sgrol zhing*// srid pa gsum na dgyes pa'i gar mdzad pa// srid pa'i chu bo skem zhing mi mthun bdud rnams 'joms// srid pa'i rlung gis mi g.yo thugs rje'i mgon// rab brjid mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// ༈ /rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad ni/ pad+ma dang nyi ma la hūm̐ mdzad nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu rang gi phyag rgyas thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis 'jigs byed mnan pa/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ kro dha rā dza hūm̐ kā ra/ bstod pa/ 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrogs shing*// bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa// dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha// bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// ri khrod ma ni/

pad dkar dang zla ba la pam̐ las lha mo ri khrod ma ser mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma rtsa zhal ser/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ re re la'ang spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa 'gying zhing bzhad pa/ phyag g.yas gsum na rdo rje/ dgra s+t+wa/ mda'/ g.yon gsum na sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ shing lo gsar pa'i sbrang yab/ gzhu rnams 'dzin pa/ me tog gis bcings pa'i ral pa'i cod pan can/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing*/ shing lo gsar pa'i sham thams gsol ba/ zhabs g.yas pa'i rting pas 'og sgo bkag cing*/ g.yon pa'i zhabs mthil stan la btsugs te bgegs kyi steng na bzhugs pa/ sku las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lta bu'i 'od zer 'phro ba/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ pi shā tsi par+ṇa sha ba rī sarba mā ra pra sha ma ni swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ ār+yā par+ṇa sha ba rī/ bstod pa/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sgyu ma yi// cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa las byung ba'i// lha mo gang gis sgrub po'i nad gdon bgegs// kun tu zhi mdzad ma la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// ༈ /dgra nag nas gsungs pa'i rdo rje dbyangs can ma ni/ pad zla la doḥyig las rdo rje dbyangs can ma zhal gsum phyag drug ma rtsa zhal dmar/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dkar ba/ phyag g.yas gsum na pad+ma/ ral gri/ gri gug g.yon gsum na 'khor lo/ rin chen/ thod pa'i 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i rol stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ pi tsu pi tsu pradz+nyā bar+dha ni/ dz+wa la dz+wa la me dhā bar+dha ni/ dhi ri dhi ri bud+dhi bar+dha ni swā hā/ mtshan sngags badz+ra sa ra swa tī/ bstod pa/ rgyal ba kun gyi gsung rab rgya mtsho yi// rnam par 'phrul pa'i dpal las legs byung zhing*// sgrub pa po la blo gros mchog ster ba// lha mo dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// ༈ /bgegs mthar byed ni/ pam̐ las pad+ma dang am̐ las nyi ma la hūm̐ las bgegs mthar byed sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/

g.yas rdo rje 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing*/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ skra kham pa gyen du brdzes pa/ rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛt hūm̐/ mtshan sngags/ badz+ra kro dha rā dza bigh+nān+ta kṛt/ bstod pa/ 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra sogs// ༈ /ral gcig ma ni/ pad nyi la ṭām̐ ngam hūm̐ las lha mo ral gcig ma sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ dang po gnyis gri gug dang thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ g.yas 'og mas ral gri/ g.yon 'og mas ut+pa la 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra kham pa gyen du brdzes pa/ nu 'bur rgyas shing gsus pa 'phyang ba/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ thod pa dang me tog gi phreng ba dang sbrul sngon po dang g.yer kha la sogs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ hrīṃ trīṃhūm̐ phaṭa/ mtshan sngags/ ār+yā e ka dza ṭī/ bstod pa/ dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs spyi bstod bya// ༈ /dug sel ma ni/ pad nyi la dzam̐ las 'phags ma dug sel ma ser mo zhal gsum ma sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun dang ldan zhing spyan gsum gsum mnga' ba/ zhal 'dzum zhing khro ba/ phyag drug gi g.yas na rdo rje/ ral gri/ gar gyi tshul gyis mda'/ g.yon na sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ dug gi me tog sngon po/ gzhu rnams 'dzin pa/ me tog dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ na maḥsha ra ba ra/ ku mā rī/ tsurtsa ri/ tsa h-i tsa la ya/ tsurtsa la ya/ saṃ gha ṭa ni/ ma hā mā taṅgi/ a haṃ bi dhe/ a dhe/ oṃ dzāṃ swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ ār+yā dzaṃ gu li/ spyi bstod bya//

༈ /rigs byed ma dkar dmar ni pad nyi la tām̐ las rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le sku mdog dkar dmar zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis kyis ut+pa la'i mda' gzhu rna ba'i drung du 'gengs shing*/ g.yas 'og ma mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ g.yon 'og mas ut+pal 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing*/ dar dmar po'i stod g.yogs dang sham thabs can/ 'dod pa'i lha chung ma dang bcas pa'i steng na rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ ku ru kul+le swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ ār+yā ku ru kul+le/ bstod pa/ brtse bas rjes chags pad+ma rā ga'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis mdzes pa'i sku// mda' gzhu ut+pal mi 'jigs phyag rgya can// bcom ldan rigs byed ma la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// ༈ /rtog pa las gsungs pa'i ku ru kul+le ni/ pad dmar dang zla ba la hrīḥlas rigs byed ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'gengs pa/ g.yas 'og mas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ g.yon 'og mas ut+pa la dmar po 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar dmar po'i na bza' can/ 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba/ rigs byed kyi phug tu sgra gcan gyi mgo bo la gnas pa'i 'dod lha chung ma dang bcas pa'i steng na g.yon brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥhūm̐ swā hā/ mtshan sngags dang bstod pa 'dra// ༈ /sgrol ma mngon 'byung nas byung ba'i lha mo rigs byed ma ni/ gzhan thams cad gong bzhin las/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis ut+pa la'i mda' gzhu/ g.yas 'og mas mchog sbyin/ oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥswā hā/ bstod pa'i tshig rkang gsum pa/ mda' gzhu ut+pal mchog sbyin phyag rgya can// zhes sogs brjod// ༈ /o ḍi yā na'i rigs byed ma dang 'og nas 'byung ba'i rigs byed ma ni/

pad nyi la hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi me ri dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su e'i rnam pa'i chos 'byung dkar dmar gyi nang du hrīḥlas byung ba'i pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar ram̐ las nyi ma dang ro'i gdan la hrīḥlas rje btsun ma ku ru kul+le sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis kyis ut+pa la'i mda' gzhu/ g.yas 'og mas ut+pa la dmar po las byas pa'i lcags kyu dang*/ g.yon 'og mas ut+pa la dmar po'i steng na thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra kham pa gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo skam po'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/ g.yon brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥswā hā/ mtshan sngags/ ār+yā ku ru kul+le/ bstod pa'i tshig rkang gsum pa/ mda' gzhu ut+pal dbang gi lcags kyu bsnams zhes brjod/ gzhan 'dra'o// ༈ /khams gsum dbang du byed pa'i spyan ras gzigs ni/ lug gnyis zhags pas sbrel ba'i steng du pad nyi la hṝḥlas khams gsum dbang du byed pa'i spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i zhags pa dang g.yon lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i cod pan can/ sna tshogs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ sprul pa sna tshogs 'phro zhing rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis dbang bskur ba/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis mchod pa byed pa/ rig pa 'dzin pa dang*/ khyab 'jug dang*/ bde byed dang*/ tshangs pa dang*/ rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis gar dang sil snyan rdung 'khrol byed pa/ 'byung po'i tshogs mi'i mgo bo dang*/

keng rus la sogs pas brgyan pa du mas gdugs dang rnga yab la sogs pas bkur bsti byed pa'i 'khor gyi tshogs du mas bskor ba/ 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ hrī hūm̐ āḥ mtshan sngags/ trai lo kya ba shaṃ ka ra lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra/ bstod pa/ dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs spyi bstod bya/ gang ba bzang po'i rgyud nas bshad pa'i dpal gnod gnas 'khor bcas ni/ thabs dang shes rab kyi ngo bo'i zla ba dkar dmar yongs su gyur pa las byung ba'i pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba la bam̐ yig las lha mo nor rgyun ma/ shar du bzang mo/ lhor rab tu bzang mo/ nub tu sbas ma/ byang du rab tu sbas ma/ shar lhor lha mo/ lho nub tu dbyangs can ma/ nub byang du 'phags ma/ byang shar du zla shel can rnams sku mdog ser mo g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon 'bras kyi snye ma 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ gtso mo'i bha ga'i nang du gzhal yas khang pa'i dbus su dzam̐ las dpal gnod gnas sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas bī dza pū ra ka dang*/ g.yon ne'u le 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis kyis dung dang pad+ma'i tshogs mnan zhing rin po che'i char 'bebs pa/ ut+pa la sngon po'i phreng ba can/ nor rgyun ma ser mo 'bras kyi snye ma 'dzin pa la 'khyud pa/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems phyir 'phros pa rin po che'i tshogs nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab par gyur te sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus shing yongs su gyur pa las gnod sbyin chen po bcu drug tu gyur te shar du gang ba bzang po dmar po/ lhor rnam thos sras ser po/ nub tu nor sbyin dmar po/ byang du nor bu bzang po ser po/ shar lhor tsi pi kuṇ+ḍa lī dmar po/ lho nub tu rol pa'i phreng ba sngon po/ nub byang du spyod pa'i dbang po ser po/

byang shar du sgo'i dbang po ser po ste thams cad kyang bī dza pū ra ka dang ne'u le 'dzin pa/ shar sgor nor sbyin dang nor sbyin chen po/ lho sgor pad+ma dang pad+ma chen po/ nub sgor ke li dang ke li chen po/ byang sgor gang ba dang gang ba bzang po ste thams cad kyang sku mdog ser po gcer bu dbang po 'phyang ba/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi char 'bebs pa/ rin chen 'byung ldan gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lngas dbur brgyan te de rnams kyis kyang rin po che'i char 'bebs pa'o// oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+rā ya swā hā/ oṃ ba su dha ri ṇ+yai swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ shrī dzam+bha la sa pa ri wā ra/ bstod pa/ gang sngon sbyin pa rgya mtsho'i dge bsags pas// tshe dang nor dang mthu yi dpal brnyes nas// sgrub pa po la dbyig gi char 'bebs pa// nor sbyin rnams la bstod cing phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// ༈ /rgya nag rim pa'i sgrol ma ni/ gong gi ral gcig ma dang gcig par snang yang rjes gnang zur du mdzad pas/ pad nyi la ṭām̐ ngam hūm̐ las rje btsun ma sgrol ma nag mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ dang po gnyis gri gug dang thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ g.yas 'og mas ral gri/ g.yon 'og mas ut+pa la/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra khams pa gyen du brdzes pa/ nu 'bur rgyas shing gsus pa 'phyang ba/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ thod pa dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ ro'i gdan la g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ hrīṃ trīṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ mtshan sngags/ ār+yā tā rā/ bstod pa/ 'gro ba 'jigs pas nyen pa bskyab pa'i phyir// brtse bas 'jigs byed lha mo'i skur bstan nas// dbugs 'byin mdzad cing dngos grub mchog stsol ma// sgrol ma drag mo 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// ༈ /gur nas 'byung ba'i rdo rje sgrol ma ni/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ yig las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ yig gis mtshan pa/

de las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba gur bla bre ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba la hūm̐ las rdo rje sgrol ma ser mo zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma/ rtsa zhal ser/ g.yas gnag g.yon dmar/ rgyab dkar ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas bzhi na rdo rje/ mda'/ dung*/ mchog sbyin/ g.yon bzhi na ut+pa la/ gzhu/ lcags kyu/ sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa rnams 'dzin pa/ shar du oṃ las me tog sgrol ma dkar mo me tog lhor tā las bdug spos sgrol ma nag mo spos snod/ nub tu re las mar me sgrol ma ser mo mar me/ byang du tuta las dri'i sgrol ma dmar mo dung chos/ mtshams kyis 'dab ma bzhi la shar lhor 'khor lo/ lho nub tu rin po che/ nub byang du pad+ma/ byang shar du ral gri/ shar sgor tā las lcags kyu ma dkar mo lcags kyu/ lho sgor re las zhags pa ma nag mo zhags pa/ nub sgor tu las lcags sgrog ma ser mo lcags sgrog byang sgor re las dril bu ma dmar mo dril bu/ steng du swā las gtsug tor rnam rgyal ma ser mo 'khor lo/ 'og tu hā las gnod mdzes sgrol ma nag mo sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang phyag g.yon pas sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal 'dzum zhing khro ba/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ gtso bo la mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lnga dang*/ shar phyogs pa rnams la rnam snang*/ lho phyogs pa la rin 'byung*/ nub phyogs pa la 'od dpag med/ byang phyogs pa la don grub/ steng phyogs pa la rnam snang*/ 'og phyogs pa la 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥ.ār+yā wa lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ ma hā satwā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ ma ma kṛ te/

dzam+bha ya/ stam+bha ya/ mo ha ya/ ban+dha ya/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ sarba duṣ+ṭāṃ stam+bha ni tā rā yai swā hā/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ badz+ra tā rā sa pa ri wā ra/ bstod pa/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sogs spyi bstod bya// ༈ /gshed dmar ni/ pam̐ las pad+ma dang am̐ las nyi ma la hūm̐ las gshin rje'i gshed dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas mi mgo rlon pa ser pos mtshan pa'i dbyug pa dkar po 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing*/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba 'dzin pas rang 'od kyis yum la 'khyud pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan cing*/ 'dzag pa'i mgo bo brgya phyed kyi do shal dang*/ skam po lngas dbur brgyan pa/ ma he dmar po'i steng na g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭ+ṝḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ mtshan sngags/ shrī rak+ta ya mā ri/ bstod pa/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin khyod// sogs gong gi gdong drug ltar// ༈ /'og gi gtsug tor rnam rgyal ni/ mchod rten gyi bum pa'i nang du pad zla la bh+rūm̐ las gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma sku mdog dkar mo/ zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma/ rtsa zhal dkar/ g.yas ser/ g.yon dmar ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas bzhi na sna tshogs rdo rje/ pad dkar la gnas pa'i 'od dpag med/ mda'/ mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya/ g.yon bzhi na sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa/ gzhu/ mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya/ bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa rnams 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang*/ dar gyi na bza' can/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/

oṃ bh+rūm̐ swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ bha ga wa tī uṣ+ṇī ṣa bi dza ya/ bstod pa/ dpal ldan lha mo ston ka'i zla ba'i mdog /zhal gsum phyag brgyad rab mdzes zhi ma'i sku// ye shes dpag yas tshe yi mchog stsol ma// rnam par rgyal ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// ༈ /rnam snang sgyu drwa nas byung ba'i srung ba lnga'i gtso rkyang rnams las so 'brang ni/ pad zla la pram̐ las so sor 'brang ma chen mo sku mdog ser mo zhal bzhi phyag brgyad ma/ rtsa zhal ser/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ rgyab sngo ba/ zhal re re zhing zhi ba'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas bzhi na ral gri/ 'khor lo/ rtse gsum/ mda'/ g.yon bzhi na rdo rje/ zhags pa/ dgra s+t+wa/ gzhu 'dzin pa/ zhi ba'i rgyan dang na bza' can/ g.yon brkyang ba'i rol stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+rī ṇi ma hā pra ti sā re swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ bha ga wa tī ma hā pra tri sā re/ bstod pa/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sogs spyi bstod bya// ༈ /rma bya chen mo ni/ pad zla la mam̐ las rma bya chen mo ljang gu zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ rtsa zhal ljang*/ g.yos nag g.yon dkar ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ g.yas gsum na rma bya'i mjug sgro/ mda'/ mchog sbyin/ g.yon gsum na rin po che'i rnga yab/ gzhu/ dku g.yon du bum pa rnams 'dzin pa/ zla ba'i rgyab yol can/ zhi ba'i rgyan dang na bza' 'chang ba/ phyed krung gis bzhugs pa/ don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ ma hā ma yū rī bi d+yā rā dz+nyī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ mtshan sngags/ mahā ma yū rī bid+yā rā dz+nyī// bstod pa/ dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs spyi bstod bya// ༈ /stong chen rab 'joms ni/ pad zla la brum̐ las stong chen mo rab tu 'joms ma dkar mo zhal gcig phyag drug ma/ g.yas na ral gri/ mda'/ mchog sbyin/ g.yon na gzhu/ zhags pa/ dgra s+t+wa rnams 'dzin pa/

zla ba'i rgyab rten dang*/ zhi ba'i rgyan dang cha lugs can/ rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rnam snang gis dbur brgyan/ oṃ brūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ma hā sa ha sra pra marda na pa ra sid+dhū da mī ge ma ṇi badz+ra ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ ma hā sa ha sra pra marda na/ spyi bstod bya// ༈ /gsang sngags rjes 'dzin ni/ pad nyi la hūm̐ las gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin ma sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas rdo rje dang mchog sbyin/ g.yon dgra s+t+wa dang sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ nyi ma'i rgyab yol can/ rgyan dang bzhugs tshul 'dra/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ ma hā man+t+ra ma nu dhā ri ṇi/ spyi bstod bya// ༈ /bsil ba'i tshal ni/ pad nyi la dz+rīṃ las bsil ba'i tshal chen mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas phreng ba dang mchog sbyin/ g.yon lcags kyu dang thugs kar pusti 'dzin pa/ gzhan gong dang 'dra/ 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ dz+riṃ swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ ma hā sī ta ba nī/ spyi bstod bya// ༈ /phyir zlog ma ni/ pad nyi la hūm̐ las phyir zlog ma chen mo sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag drug ma/ g.yas ral gri/ lcags kyu/ mchog sbyin/ g.yon pad dmar/ rtse gsum/ thugs kar sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ ma hā pra t+yaṅgi rā/ spyi bstod bya// ༈ /rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan ni/ pad nyi la hūm̐ las lha mo rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan zhal gsum phyag bzhi ma sku dang rtsa zhal nag g.yas dmar/ g.yon ljang ba/ mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas gnyis na ral gri dang zhags pa/ g.yon gnyis na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa/

dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ thod pa'i phreng bas brgyan cing*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ na bza' ser po'i sha 'gag can/ lto ba 'phyang ba/ g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ bha ga wa tīdhā dzā gra ke yū ra/ spyi bstod bya// ༈ /gzhan gyis mi thub ma ni/ pad nyi la tshogs bdag glang sna bsgyel ba'i steng du/ am̐ las 'phags ma gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ sku mdog ser mo g.yas thal mo brkyang ste 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ tshangs pa la sogs pa'i lha'i tshogs kyis gdugs bzung nas bskor ba/ rnam snang gis dbur brgyan/ oṃ am̐ swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ ār+yā a pa rā dzi tā/ spyi bstod bya// ༈ /rdo rje gan+dha ri ni/ pad nyi la hūm̐ las rdo rje gan+dha ri sku mdog nag mo zhal drug phyag bcu gnyis ma rtsa zhal nag g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ rgyab ljang*/ steng du ser po dang sngon po brtsegs pa'i zhal can/ phyag g.yas pa rnams na rdo rje/ dril bu/ ral gri/ rtse gsum/ mda'/ 'khor lo/ g.yon pa rnams na kha ṭ+wām̐ ga lcags kyu/ gzhu/ dgra s+t+wa/ zhags pa/ thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan cing g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma sh+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ mahā yak+ṣa se na pa ta ye/ na mo bha ga wa tī mahā badz+ra gan+dha ri/ a ne ka ra sha ta sa ha sra/ pra dza li ta/ dīp+te te dzā yai/ u gra bhī ma bha ya na ga yai/ yo gi nī yai/ bhiṣ+ma bha gi nī yai/ dwā da sha bhū dzā yai/ bi kīr+ṇa kai shi yai/ a nai ka rū pa bi bhi dha be/ sidhā ri ṇe ye/ e h+ye haṃ bha ga wa tī ma hā gan+dha ri/

sad+dha ri/ tra yā ṇī rat+na nāṃ sa t+ye na/ āka ḍ+ḍh+ya ā kaḍ+ḍh+ya/ bā de di kaṃ/ ye tsa n+ye sa ma ye na tiṣ+ṭhan+ti tā nā brta yi ṣ+ya mi/ sī gh+raṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa/ oṃ a la a la/ hu lu hu lu/ mu lu mu lu/ tsu lu tsu lu/ dha ma dha ma/ raṅga raṅga/ raṅgā pa ya raṅgā pa ya/ pū ra ya pū ra ya/ ā bi sha ā bi sha/ bha ga ba tī mahā badz+ra gan+dha ri/ sid+dha tsan+da/ badz+ra pā ṇi rā dz+nya pa ya ti/ hrīḥhāḥ.āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/

hṛ da ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā'ang snang*/ mtshan sngags/ ār+yā badz+ra gan+dha ri/ spyi bstod bya// ༈ /nag po chen po ni/ pad nyi dang ro dmar ser mgo g.yas su bstan pa'i steng du hūm̐ las dpal rdo rje nag po chen po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas gri gug dang*/ g.yon thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang ba/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ sku lus thung zhing sbom la gzi brjid che ba/ me ri 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ shrī ma hā kā la/ bstod pa/ srin po'i gzugs kyis gdug pa can// tshar gcod byang chub sems dpa' ste// grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jigs byed pa// gtum po khyod la bdag bstod do// zhes so// ༈ /rdo rje lcags sgrog ni/ pad zla la hūm̐ las rdo rje lcags sgrog ljang gu zhal gsum phyag drug pa rtsa zhal ljang*/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas gsum na rdo rje/ rdo rje lcags sgrog mda'/ g.yon gsum na sdigs mdzub/ zhags pa/ gzhu rnams 'dzin pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing zhabs g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra shrīṃ kha la hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ badz+ra shrīṃ kha la/ spyi bstod bya// ༈ /stobs po che ni/ pad dkar dang nyi ma la hūm̐ las srid pa'i khro bo stobs po che sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas gnyis na dbyug pa dkar po rnga yab dkar po/ g.yon gnyis phyag 'tshal pa'i tshul dang sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra kham pa gyen du brdzes pa/

sbrul gyis brgyan cing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ 'od zer dmar po'i dbus na g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ ma hā ba la swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ ma hā ba la/ bstod pa/ gang gi rang bzhin khro bral yang*// sogs gong ltar// ༈ /gdugs dkar ni/ pad dkar la oṃ las 'phags ma gzhan gyis mi thub ma dkar mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma rtsa zhal dkar/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dmar ba/ phyag dang po gnyis rdo rje dang 'khor lo/ bar pa gnyis mda' dang gzhu/ 'og ma gnyis lcags kyu dang sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' can/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rnam snang gis dbur brgyan/ oṃ si tā ta pa tre/ a pa rā dzi te/ sarba gra ha a nu trā sa ya/ trā sa ya/ ha na ha na/ drum̐ drum̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ ār+yā mi tā ta pa tra/ spyi bstod bya// ༈ /rta mgrin ni/ pad nyi la hūm̐ las dpal rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po zhal gsum phyag brgyad rtsa zhal dmar po bzhad pa/ g.yas sngon po ljags 'dril ba/ g.yon dkar po mche bas ma mchu mnan pa/ zhal re re zhing spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas bzhi na rdo rje dbyug pa/ pad+ma kha 'byed pa'i tshul/ mda'/ g.yon bzhi sdigs mdzub/ rang gi nu ma g.yon pa/ pad+ma/ gzhu rnams 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ sbrul gyis brgyan cing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ ha ya gṝ wa swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ ha ya gṝ wa/ bstod pa/ gang gi rang bzhin khro bral sogs kyis bstod// ༈ /kye rdo rje ni/ dur khrod kyi dbus su pad nyi la hūm̐ las dpal he ru ka sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis phyag gnyis pa g.yas 'bar ba'i rdo rje phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/

gru mo na kha ṭ+wām̐ ga ba dan rtse gsum pas brgyan pa 'chang ba/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan zhing*/ mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ dbu skra kham pa gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo'i phreng ba dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ mi lpags kyi na bza' mnabs shing thal chen gyis lus la byugs pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ shrī badz+ra he ru ka bstod pa/ thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin mchog /gdod nas thams cad bdag nyid gnas// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa// kye yi rdo rje la phyag 'tshal// zhes so// ༈ /bdag med ma'i gnyis ni/ pad zla la am̐ las rdo rje bdag med ma sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas gri gug phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ gru mo na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal dang*/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs kyis ro'i steng na bzhugs pa/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ ai ai o au aṃ swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ bha ga wa tī badz+ra nai rat+ma/ bstod pa/ 'gro ba bud med 'dul gzigs nas// bdag med rnal 'byor ma gyur gang*// phyag 'tshal pha rol phyin thub la// sgyu ma'i phyag rgyar phyag 'tshal 'dud// ces so// ༈ /rdo rje phag mo ni/ chos 'byung gru gsum dmar po'i dbus su pad+ma dmar po'i lte bar yi dwags kyi gdan la hrīḥham̐ las rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas rdo rje gri gug 'phyar ba'i tshul dang*/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/

gru mo na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ me tog gi phreng bas brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rnam snang gis dbur brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra wā rā hī/ ā we sha ya/ ā we sha ya/ sarba dza rā ṇa hrīḥswā hā/ mtshan sngags/ bha ga wa tī badz+ra wā rā hī/ bstod pa/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum brnyes// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes so// ༈ /dkar ba'i las ston pa'i sgrol ma ni/ pad nyi la hūm̐ las rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba gur bla bre ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du dur khrod brgyad kyis nye bar brgyan pa'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ am̐ las zla ba la hūm̐ las dkar ba'i las nye bar ston pa'i rje btsun ma sgrol ma dkar mo zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ rtsa zhal dkar/ g.yas ser/ g.yon nag pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas gsum na mchog sbyin/ phreng ba/ mda'/ g.yon gsum na ut+pa la/ pad+ma/ gzhu rnams 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i cod pan can/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ zla ba phyed pas thod byas pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing*/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zla ba la rgyab brten cing*/ skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa de bzhin gshegs pa rnam pa lnga 'phro ba'o// rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan/ oṃ a tsa le ā ni mit+ta wā re hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ mtshan sngags/ ār+yā tā rā/ bstod pa/ lha dang lha min sogs kyi bstod do// ༈ /sgrub thabs 'di rnams la bla ma dā byang chub sems dpa' yan lag bzhi ka dngos su bya dgos par bzhed/ bla ma bai ro tsa na 'di rnams bsdus pa'i skabs yin pas yan lag phyi ma gsum mi dgos par bzhed/

lo tsā ba yang de bde gsungs/ zhes rje sa chen gyi ṭī ka las byung ngo*// ༈ /de ltar sgrub thabs kun las btus// brgya rtsar grags pa'i bstan bcos kyi// don 'grel mun sel sgron me 'di// 'dren mchog bla ma'i gsung bzhin bkod// 'di la nongs pa'i cha mchis na// sgo gsum sdig dang lhan cig tu// bla ma mchog dang yi dam lha// dbyer med spyan sngar mthol zhing bshags// legs pa'i dge ba ci mchis des// bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi// sgo gsum lha sngags ye shes su// mngon gyur rdo rje'i sa thob shog/ ༈ /sgrub thabs brgya rtsa nas bshad pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi mngon rtogs rjes gnang gi cho ga dang bcas pa'i tho yig mun sel sgron me zhes bya ba 'di ni/ skye rgu'i gtsug rgyan bdag chen rin po che ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i bka' lung nan tan chen pos bskul ba la brten nas/ 'dren mchog chos kyi rgyal po rat+na war+dha yab sras kyi bka' drin gyis nye bar 'tsho ba/ shākya'i btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis/ sgrub thabs kyi gzhung so so dang*/ dpal sa skya pa yab sras kyis mdzad pa'i ṭī ka dang*/ gtad rgya la sogs pa lugs 'di la dgos pa'i yig sna khungs thub rnams la legs par gtugs te/ yongs 'dzin gyi lo gro bzhin zla ba'i tshes bco brgyad kyi nyin dpal e waṃ chos ldan gyi ri khrod du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni brda sprod pa blo gros bkra shis so// ༈ /'dis bstan pa dang sems can la phan thogs par gyur cig sgrub thabs dgu bcu go gnyis la ris mthun rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pas rjes gnang bdun cu don dgu yod do// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/
